text_blocks.snippet: Frequent acid reflux, also known as heartburn, can be caused by a variety of factors, including diet, lifestyle, and underlying medical conditions. Common culprits include consuming trigger foods like spicy or acidic items, being overweight or pregnant, and using certain medications. Additionally, conditions like GERD, hiatal hernias, and even stress can contribute to persistent acid reflux.
